newsitem.title: CHINA: China plant alumina output 426,600 tonnes in H1.
newsitem.headline: China plant alumina output 426,600 tonnes in H1.

text.p: China's Shanxi Aluminium Factory, the biggest domestic producer of alumina, produced 426,600 tonnes of the industrial raw material in the first half, a factory official said on Wednesday.
"Alumina output is expected to exceed 850,000 tonnes this year," the official said by telephone from Hejin city in the northern province of Shanxi.
Most of the product was sold in the domestic market with only a small quantity exported in the form of aluminium hydroxide, he said, but declined to give figures.
Plant officials have previously said the factory produced 750,000 tonnes of alumina, or aluminium oxide, in 1996.
At present, domestic alumina prices were flat -- around 2,300 yuan ($277) per tonne compared with a high of 3,000 yuan, he said. The production cost was 1,400 yuan per tonne.
The factory posted a net loss in the first quarter, mainly due to large interest payments to banks, but managed a profit for the first half, the official said.
The loans were taken out during construction of the plant, which began production in 1987, he said, without giving details.
"We aim to be profitable in 1997," he said. The plant was loss-making last year.
